title: Quadratic bit of an appended vector
statement: Let $m,p$ be nonnegative integers, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^m$ and $y\in\mathbb{F}_2^p$. The complete quadratic bit of the vector formed by appending $y$ to $x$ equals the complete quadratic bit of $x$, plus that of $y$, plus $(\sum_i x_i)(\sum_j y_j)$, with all operations in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
